dialogue.content: （こんばんは。待機しておりますので、時間になりましたら宜しくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I'm on standby, so please begin when you're ready.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Likewise, thank you.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。ご相談にお越し下さって、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for reaching out today.

dialogue.content: はいお願い致します
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: はじめに、宜しければ年齢と性別をお伺いできますか？
dialogue.English: To start, if you don't mind, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 40代女性です
dialogue.English: I'm a woman in my 40s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは、今日のお話の内容をお伺いできますか？
dialogue.English: Alright then, could you tell me what you would like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 母親が面倒をみて欲しいと言ってきて困っています
dialogue.English: I'm troubled because my mother is asking me to take care of her.

dialogue.content: お母様が望んでおられるのは、同居して面倒を見て欲しいということなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is your mother hoping that you live together and take care of her?

dialogue.content: そうなのです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: お母様は、ご自分のお母様ですか？それとも義理のお母様でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is she your own mother, or your mother-in-law?

dialogue.content: 自分の母親ですが嫌いなのです
dialogue.English: She's my own mother, but I dislike her.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、ご自身で嫌いと思われているお母様なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so this is a mother you feel you dislike.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: となると、
dialogue.English: In that case,

dialogue.content: 実生活で同居するのがお困りになると言う意味が分かります。お困りですね、確かに。
dialogue.English: I can understand why living with her would be difficult for you. That is indeed a difficult situation.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: お差し支え無ければ、今一緒に住んでいる家族構成を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.English: If it's alright, could you tell me who you currently live with?

dialogue.content: 独身で一人暮らしです
dialogue.English: I'm single and live alone.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それでは一対一の状況で、お困りになるのは無理はありませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it's no wonder you're finding this one-on-one situation so difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんです姉は結婚してて遠いので
dialogue.English: Yes—that's right. My older sister is married and lives far away.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、お姉様もいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you have an older sister as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母様を嫌いと感じるようになったのは、いつごろからでしょう？
dialogue.English: When did you start feeling dislike towards your mother?

dialogue.content: もう子供のころから嫌いです
dialogue.English: I've disliked her ever since I was a child.

dialogue.content: 小学生くらいかな
dialogue.English: Since I was in elementary school, I think.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。小学生くらいの時、嫌いになってしまったきっかけなど、お心当たりはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you recall anything happening around elementary school that might have caused you to start disliking her?

dialogue.content: 母親なのに自分の人生を生きたと家を出ていきました
dialogue.English: Even though she was my mother, she left home to live her own life.

dialogue.content: 今頃きても無理なんです
dialogue.English: It's impossible for me now that she shows up after all this time.

dialogue.content: お母様は家を出てしまったと言うことですか？もしそうだとすれば、
dialogue.English: So your mother left home? If that's the case,

dialogue.content: 小学生という多感な時期にとても辛い思いをなさったのですね。
dialogue.English: you must have gone through a very painful experience during such a sensitive time in elementary school.

dialogue.content: そうですねなのに面倒みて欲しいなんて許せないです
dialogue.English: That's right. For her to ask me to take care of her now... I can't forgive her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、それでは自分で勝手に振る舞っていながら、今更のようなイメージになってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So it feels like she acted selfishly and is now coming back after all this time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母様が家から居なくなってしまったとき、どんなことを一番嫌だと感じましたか？
dialogue.English: When your mother left home, what did you find most upsetting?

dialogue.content: お辛い記憶だと思いますので、お話ししにくいことは話さなくて大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: I know it must be a painful memory, so please don't feel you have to talk about anything that's too difficult.

dialogue.content: 父親が頑張ってくれたので悲しかったけど嫌だとは感じなかったかも？
dialogue.English: My father worked so hard for me, so while I was sad, I don't think I felt it was awful.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それではお父様のお陰で今まで頑張っていられたのですね？
dialogue.English: I see, so you were able to get through it thanks to your father?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 出て行ったことが嫌だったかな…
dialogue.English: Maybe what I hated was that she left...

dialogue.content: 小学生という年齢で、お母様が家から出てしまわれた、けれどお父様には大事にされてきたということですね？
dialogue.English: When you were in elementary school, your mother left home, but your father took good care of you—does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そうです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 小学生で、自分の母親が死別ではないのに居なくなる、というのは
dialogue.English: Being in elementary school and having your mother be gone—not due to bereavement—

dialogue.content: 本当に寂しいし、毎日がしんどかったですね。
dialogue.English: must have been truly lonely, and everyday life must have been hard.

dialogue.content: はい、その頃はそう思ってました
dialogue.English: Yes, that's how I felt at the time.

dialogue.content: それはもう当然だと思います。特に多感な時期ですし。
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable, especially at such a sensitive age.

dialogue.content: そんな母親を面倒みないと駄目でしょうか
dialogue.English: Do I have to take care of a mother like that?

dialogue.content: 一概には言えませんが、身勝手なことだと感じます。
dialogue.English: I can't say for certain, but it does feel selfish.

dialogue.content: 私がですか？
dialogue.English: Me?

dialogue.content: いえいえ、お母様です。言葉が足りずすみません。
dialogue.English: No, no, your mother. I'm sorry for not being clear.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 一概には言えないというのはどういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean when you say you "can't say for certain"?

dialogue.content: それでは、そのお母様の面倒を見て欲しいということを、お断りなさりたいという・・・
dialogue.English: So, you'd like to refuse your mother's request to take care of her...

dialogue.content: それを悩んでいます
dialogue.English: That's what I'm struggling with.

dialogue.content: 一概に、と言ったのは、その出て行かれたご事情までが分からなかったので、ということなのですが。
dialogue.English: When I said "for certain," it was because I don't know the full circumstances of why she left.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それでは、お母様の申し出をお断りすることを前提に、ご一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: In that case, assuming you will decline your mother's request, let's think through this together.

dialogue.content: それとも、他に解決したいことがおありですか？
dialogue.English: Or is there something else you'd like to resolve?

dialogue.content: 他にはないです
dialogue.English: No, nothing else.

dialogue.content: 承知致しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: 少しお話しさせて頂くと、
dialogue.English: Allow me to share a few thoughts.

dialogue.content: 今のお母様がどのような状況かは分かりませんが、あなた様が一手に面倒をみる責任はないと考えます。
dialogue.English: I don't know your mother's current situation, but I don't believe you bear the sole responsibility of caring for her.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし、経済的に困っているような状況でしたら、
dialogue.English: If she is in financial difficulty,

dialogue.content: 生活保護を受けてもらうということも考えられますし、
dialogue.English: one option is for her to apply for public assistance,

dialogue.content: ご高齢になって、介護が必要なようであれば、
dialogue.English: and if she's elderly and needs care,

dialogue.content: 生活保護を受けながら、施設へ入所するということも出来ると思います。
dialogue.English: I believe it's also possible for her to enter a facility while receiving public assistance.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね施設にはいれるのですね
dialogue.English: I see—so she could enter a facility.

dialogue.content: 施設に入れるかというのは、要介護度の程度によりますが、
dialogue.English: Whether she can enter a facility depends on the level of care she needs, but...

dialogue.content: 60代後半ですが　健康です
dialogue.English: She's in her late 60s but is healthy.

dialogue.content: なるほど、ご健康なのですね？となると、
dialogue.English: I see, so she's in good health? In that case,

dialogue.content: お母様の居住地域の福祉事務所にご自身で出向いてもらい、
dialogue.English: she could go to the welfare office in her area herself,

dialogue.content: ご自身で生活保護の申請をしてもらっては如何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: and apply for public assistance on her own—would that be an option?

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: あとは、もう年金をもらえる年齢なので、
dialogue.English: Also, she is old enough to receive a pension, so

dialogue.content: 年金の金額で暮らせないという判断を「福祉事務所」がすれば、足りないところの差額をもらえるのではと考えます。
dialogue.English: if the welfare office determines that she can't make ends meet on her pension, she may be able to receive supplemental benefits to cover the shortfall.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 考えてみます
dialogue.English: I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょう？お母様に今のわたしがお伝えした内容を、話して断ることは出来そうですか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound? Do you feel you could explain what I've shared to your mother and decline?

dialogue.content: それと同時に、
dialogue.English: At the same time,

dialogue.content: もしお母様に家を出て行ったいきさつを訊いてみたり、またはあなた様の感じた悲しさをお伝えし、
dialogue.English: you might ask her about the circumstances under which she left home, or share the sadness you felt,

dialogue.content: これが同居したくない理由だというような、小学生当時に言いたかったことを伝えては如何でしょう？
dialogue.English: and convey the things you wanted to say as a child, explaining that this is the reason you don't want to live with her?

dialogue.content: そうですね人間的に母親の面倒を見ないのはどうか悩んでいたので聞いてみます
dialogue.English: You're right. I've been struggling with whether it's okay, as a person, not to take care of my mother, so I'll try asking her.

dialogue.content: あなた様にもまた、人権や尊重されるべき心の問題がありますから、
dialogue.English: You also have your own rights and emotional well-being that deserve respect,

dialogue.content: 最終的にはあなた様の決定になりますが、その判断をしたからと言って誰も責めることは出来ません。
dialogue.English: Ultimately, the decision is yours, but no one can blame you for whatever choice you make.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ご自分だけが被らなくて良いのですよ。
dialogue.English: You don't have to bear this burden all by yourself.

dialogue.content: そうですよね
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: 気持ちが楽になりました
dialogue.English: I feel relieved.

dialogue.content: あなたは子供の頃に、酷く傷ついていらっしゃるのですから。
dialogue.English: You were deeply hurt as a child.

dialogue.content: 子供の面倒をみることと、親の面倒を見ることは意義が違うとも考えます。
dialogue.English: I believe there's a difference in meaning between looking after a child and looking after a parent.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 親には子供に対する責任がありますよね。けれど、それを放棄されてしまうという大変な辛さをもう味わっているのですから、
dialogue.English: Parents have a responsibility to their children, don't they? But you have already experienced the immense pain of having that responsibility abandoned,

dialogue.content: お母様には、家を出たときの気持ちを思いだしてもらいましょう。自分の人生をご自身でお決めになったのですから・・・
dialogue.English: Let's have your mother recall how she felt when she left home. She made her own decision about her life...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます言いたい事を代わりに言ってもらえた気がします
dialogue.English: Thank you. I feel like you've said the things I wanted to say for me.

dialogue.content: 大人には判断力という物があります。当時のお母様はご自身で判断したのですから・・・
dialogue.English: Adults have the ability to make decisions. Your mother made her own choice back then...

dialogue.content: 大事なお話の途中ですが、もうすぐお時間となってしまいました。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt this important conversation, but our time is almost up.

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: お母様にお話出来そうですか？またその結果に悩んだらぜひお越し下さいね。
dialogue.English: Do you think you'll be able to speak with your mother? If you struggle with the outcome, please come back and talk to me again.

dialogue.content: 言ってみます
dialogue.English: I'll try telling her.

dialogue.content: 少しでもお役に立てれば嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I hope this has been of some help.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ご自身を大切に、寂しかったころの分も、これから幸せになって下さいね。
dialogue.English: Please take care of yourself, and I hope you find happiness now to make up for the loneliness you felt back then.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは終了のメッセージを送らせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: I will now send the closing message.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: (はいカウンセラーありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Yes, thank you, counselor.)

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)
